one_liner.title: One Liner (RHP)
one_liner.body: A Noida-based IVD and medical-device manufacturer providing affordable diagnostic kits, reagents and analysers to labs, hospitals and government buyers in India and overseas.

business_model.title: What they do
business_model.body: Avience Biomedicals Limited, established in 2019, is a medical-consumable company that manufactures in-vitro diagnostic (IVD) products and medical devices from its facility in Noida, Uttar Pradesh. Its range spans IVD rapid test kits (VTM, Covid, HIV, HBsAg, Malaria, Dengue and others), serology products, biochemistry analysers, biochemistry reagents and culture media. It sells B2B, B2C and B2G to pathology/microbiology labs, hospitals and research centres nationwide and to export markets, and also acts as a distributor/trader of medical equipment.

group_structure.title: Group structure (subsidiaries / JV / related parties)
group_structure.body:
- DR Meditech Surgical and Diagnostics (India) Private Limited — Common directorship (Dharam Deo Choudhary, Ram Nagina Choudhary, Janardan Pal): Other directorship of promoter/directors
- Imperative Healthcare Private Limited — Other directorship of director Deepa Choudhary

products.title: Products & brands
products.body:
- **IVD Rapid Test Kits:** Viral Transport Media (VTM), Covid, HIV 1/2 Antibody Rapid Test, HBsAg Rapid Test, HCV Ab Rapid Test, Malaria Pf/Pan/Pv Antigen Rapid Test, Dengue NS1 / IgG-IgM Rapid Test, Typhoid IgG/IgM Rapid Test, Syphilis Rapid Test, Sickle Cell Rapid Test, Scrub Typhus IgG/IgM Test, Kala Azar Antibody Test, Leptospira IgG/IgM Test, H. pylori Antibody Test, Pregnancy Card / Strips, HCG / LH / FSH Test
- **Serology Products:** Serology products, Antistreptolysin-O (ASO) Latex, C-Reactive Protein (CRP) Latex, Rheumatoid Factor (RF) Latex
- **Biochemistry:** Semi Automatic Biochemistry Analyzer, Full Auto Biochemistry Analyser, Biochemistry Reagent kits (Glucose GOD-POD, Creatinine Jaffe, Urea, Uric Acid, Bilirubin, ALT/SGPT, AST/SGOT, ALP, Cholesterol, HDL/LDL, Triglycerides, Albumin, Calcium, Magnesium, Amylase, CK-MB/CK-NAC, Gamma GT, LDH, Phosphorous, Protein)
- **Analyzers / Instruments:** Hematology Analyser (5-Part), Blood Cell Count Analyzer, Electrolyte analyzer AVLyte-80, Glycated Haemoglobin (HbA1c) Analyser, Semi Auto Coagulation Analyser, Urine Analyser, ESR Analyser
- **Reagents & Other Consumables:** Reagent kits and cleaners, Culture Media, Centrifuge Tubes (15/50 ml), Micro Centrifuge Tubes, Specimen Collection Containers, Blood Cell Diluents / Lyse / Cleaners

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Hybrid model of in-house manufacturing plus trading/distribution. Backward: sources raw materials both domestically (94.69%-99.43% of purchases across FY23-stub) and via imports (0.57%-5.31%); key inputs include nitrocellulose membrane, monoclonal/polyclonal antibodies, recombinant antigens and quality-control reagents (largely from FAPON), analyser cards, PCR master mixes and packaging. Company has increased in-house manufacturing to reduce dependence on third-party suppliers, and direct costs as a % of revenue fell from 65.05% (FY24) to 59.83% (FY25). Forward: acts as authorised channel partner (trading) of Mindray Medical India; distributes across B2B (distributors/traders), B2C (hospitals, diagnostic labs) and B2G (government/PSU tenders). Trading purchases and sales are significantly routed through wholly-owned subsidiary DR Meditech Surgical and Diagnostics Private Limited (purchases 1.21%-15.87% of total purchases; sales 14.75%-61.30% of revenue across periods). Post-sales AMC/CMC service revenue is a small but growing stream from FY2024-25.

demand_drivers.title: Demand & outlook drivers
demand_drivers.body:
- Revenue mix is trading-heavy (trading ~68-84% of revenue across years), with manufacturing rising as capacity is added
- Domestic sales dominate but exports have been volatile (18.15% of revenue in FY25 vs 1.76% in the Jan-2026 period)
- Sharp EBITDA-margin expansion (standalone 13.05% FY23 to 26.49% FY25) on rising capacity utilisation and operating leverage
- Working-capital cycle reflected in a current ratio around 1.40 (standalone FY25)
- State concentration in Delhi and Uttar Pradesh drives revenue

capital_allocation.title: Strategy & capital allocation
capital_allocation.body:
- Expand manufacturing capacity and diversify the product range
- Set up a new manufacturing unit at the Medical Device Park, YEIDA
- Broaden the geographic footprint, including exports to African and other overseas markets
- Continue adding manufacturing licenses for new IVD products, reagents and analysers

capex_expansion.title: Capex & expansion plans
capex_expansion.body: Avience is developing a new, larger manufacturing facility at the Medical Device Park under the Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority (YEIDA), Gautam Buddha Nagar, on 2,100 sq. meters of allotted commercial land (Plot No. 70, Sector-28), with the foundation stone laid in FY2024-25; a portion of the IPO net proceeds is earmarked to part-finance the capex for this new unit. It has also received an allotment letter for a 1,000 sq. meter industrial plot on the Yamuna Expressway (Sector-29). The build-out supports the company's stated intent to expand capacity and diversify its product line beyond the existing leasehold Noida facility.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Diversified IVD and medical-device product portfolio built through a rapidly expanding set of CDSCO manufacturing licenses
- Multiple quality accreditations (ISO 9001:2016, ISO 13485, WHO GMP, ZED MSME Gold, CDSCO compliance)
- One of few Indian manufacturers with ICMR validation for the sickle cell test
- In-house manufacturing capability across rapid tests, reagents, culture media and analysers combined with trading/distribution
- Promoter-led leadership with ~30 years of industry experience
- Established B2B, B2C and B2G channels across North India plus a growing export presence

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Extensive and evolving regulation of the IVD/pharmaceutical market across India and export countries — Non-compliance could trigger show-cause notices, product recalls, penalties, loss of approvals and revenue
- Customer concentration — Dependence on certain customers for a portion of revenues; loss of a major customer could adversely affect results
- Trading-heavy revenue mix — Trading (resale) accounts for the majority of revenue (~68-84%), diluting the manufacturing value-add and margins
- Export-market regulatory dependence — Exports to Dubai, Ethiopia, Ghana, Somalia, Nepal and Zambia require compliance with multiple foreign regulatory authorities
- Geographic revenue concentration — Revenue skewed to Delhi and Uttar Pradesh, exposing the company to regional demand and tender cycles
- Execution risk on the new YEIDA facility — IPO-funded capex expansion depends on timely construction, licensing and ramp-up of the new plant
- Small-scale MSME/SME profile — Startup/MSME issuer with limited scale and funding depth, constraining resilience to shocks

commitments.title: Promises (RHP)
commitments.body:
- **Part-finance the capital expenditure for setting up a new manufacturing unit at Plot No. 70, Sector-28, Medical Device Park, YEIDA, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, funded from IPO net proceeds.**
- **Utilise IPO net proceeds to fund the working capital requirement of the Company.**
- **Develop the allotted 2,100 sq. meter commercial land in the Medical Device Park (YEIDA) into a larger production facility, following foundation-stone laying in FY2024-25.**
- **Continue expanding manufacturing capacity and diversifying the product range into analysers, instruments and biochemistry reagents.**
- **Expand export presence internationally, building on entry into the African continent (Somalia) and Ethiopian (EFDA) approval.**
- **Improve/sustain capacity utilisation on rapid tests and reagents (Rapid Test utilisation 84.12% and Reagents 85.23% for the period ended Jan 31, 2026).**
- **Continue adding CDSCO manufacturing licenses across new IVD tests, reagents and analysers (10 new licenses received in FY2026-27, incl. HbA1c Analyser, 5-Part Hematology Analyser and Full Auto Biochemistry Analyser).**
- **Sustain/improve capacity utilisation on rapid tests and reagents (Rapid Test 84.12% and Reagents 85.23% for the period ended Jan 31, 2026).**
